Most card processors refuse research peptide stores. Here is how I solved that for a US peptide brand, so buyers can still pay at checkout and the owner stays in control. Client name kept private.
A manual-payment checkout that still feels like checkout.
Instead of sending payment details by email after the order, buyers pay on the spot:

• 1They pick Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, PayPal, bank transfer or USDC right at checkout.
  • 2The store's details, exact amount and order reference appear with one-tap copy buttons.
  • 3They upload proof of payment before placing the order.
  • 4The order waits On hold until the owner checks the receipt and approves it.

Most stores go live in 7–10 days: free call on day 1, design on days 2–3, build on days 4–7, testing on days 8–9 and launch on day 10. Bigger catalogues or custom features can take a little longer.

WordPress websites start from $300, WooCommerce stores from $450, research peptide stores from $600, and landing pages or redesigns from $150. You get a fixed quote after the free call.

Yes. They include a COA page for every batch, an age gate, “research use only” notices, clear product specs and a payment setup suited to the niche.

WooCommerce gives you full ownership of your site and data, no platform fee per sale, full design freedom, and it works for niches some platforms restrict. Shopify is quick to start but adds monthly plan and app costs.

Product photos, product details (names, prices, variants, descriptions), an approved payment account, and your shipping and returns policy. Don’t have them all yet? We’ll plan around it on the call.
